title: TikTok: If everyone got $1 million (vertical, hook)

lines.text: If everyone on Earth got one million dollars, this coffee could cost four hundred dollars.
Imagine you wake up, check your bank account, and there it is: one million dollars.
Not just you. Your neighbor, your boss, the barista. Every single person on Earth.
For a few days, everyone feels rich. People buy new cars, phones and vacations.
But here is the catch. The number of cars, phones and plane seats did not change. Only the amount of money did.
When more money chases the same stuff, sellers do the obvious thing. They raise their prices.
A coffee that cost four dollars yesterday could cost forty next week. And four hundred a few weeks later.
Everyone is a millionaire. And that is exactly why being a millionaire suddenly means almost nothing.
So, would a million for everyone make us all rich? No. It would make us all millionaires. And that is not the same thing.
